name: filter-chip
title: FilterChip
summary: Applied-filter chip with operator + value display + optional dropdown editor + dismiss X. Shape is `{label} {operator-label} {value}`. Used in the row above a DataTable to show what's currently filtering the view.
description: Applied-filter chip — {field} {operator} {value} with edit popover + dismiss X.
skillDescription: Use above a DataTable / list to show what's currently filtering the view. Each chip = one applied filter. Click the chip to edit (optional Popover); X to remove. For full query building use @lumen/filter-builder.
useWhen: Above a DataTable showing applied filters.
Active-state indicator on a saved view.
Compact filter display in a TopBar context.
never: NEVER omit onRemove — the point of a chip is dismissibility.
NEVER use FilterChip for non-applied filters (use Tag).
do: Show all three parts (field + operator + value) for clarity.
